desc: Engineered with precision and tailored for the avid hunter, the ELEMENT II boasts an array of features designed to elevate your shooting experience. It features oversized controls, including a larger slammer button, charging handle, and safety, to ensure seamless operation in less-than-ideal conditions. The ELEMENT II utilizes their field-proven inertia recoil system, which provides reliable cycling shot after shot. Available in 12 and 20 gauge with a 28" barrel, the ELEMENT II was designed to excel in any hunting situation.
